queries:
WITH mt AS (
  SELECT m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM mt
)
SELECT AVG(mt.rate) AS avg_rate,
       AVG(mt.cnt) AS avg_track_count,
       AVG(mt.rate - overall.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_diff
FROM mt, overall
WHERE mt.rate > overall.avg_rate;
SELECT Album.Title, COUNT(Track.Bytes) FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId;
SELECT SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) FROM Track
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track AS T1 JOIN MediaType AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T1.MediaTypeId
SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS Rate
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name;
